stories.message: Home menu shows Pizzas above Drinks (acceptance line 1 met). Acceptance line 2 is not met: MenuApi's category order (Drinks, Pizzas, Sides) is alphabetical and represents the categories' pre-change relative order. The rendered home page order is Pizzas, Sides, Drinks -- Sides now sits before Drinks, reversing their earlier relative order, so a category other than Pizzas did not keep its position relative to the other categories.
evidence: GET /preview/MenuApi categories order: Drinks, Pizzas, Sides
Home page (anonymous) text dump order: Pizzas, Sides, Drinks

stories.message: 'We deliver within 3 miles' appears directly under the shop name in the home page hero. But the shop name 'Harbor Street Pizza' is also shown to customers in the top nav/shell header on every other customer-facing page checked (/basket, /checkout, the order confirmation page /order/:code), and the note is absent there, so it is not present 'wherever the shop name is shown to customers' as the acceptance line requires.
evidence: Home page text dump: nav 'Harbor Street Pizza' then hero 'Harbor Street Pizza / We deliver within 3 miles'
/basket text dump: 'Harbor Street Pizza / Sign in / Your basket' -- no delivery line
/checkout text dump: 'Harbor Street Pizza / Sign in / Checkout' -- no delivery line
/order/<code> confirmation text dump: 'Harbor Street Pizza / Sign in / Order confirmation...' -- no delivery line

notes: Walk scoped to the two stories about this look/content change (pizza-before-drinks ordering, delivery-radius note) plus the standard cross-cutting probes. Did not re-walk admin menu/order-update flows this round, which earlier runs reported as broken (MenuAdminApi/OrderAdminApi 400s) -- not re-verified here since no story in this batch touches them.
